verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure on a common left edge: logo, headline, subhead, steps 01-03 in order, then the CTA. Its only flaws are the near-illegible legal footer and some dead space below the CTA. B scrambles the reading order (02 and 03 above the headline, 01 below it, the ULTRA logo stranded mid-canvas), shrinks the step text to an unreadable few pixels, and scatters elements off-grid.

A is broken: the step copy is microscopic, 01 and 02 sit above the headline while 03 sits below it, the subhead falls below its own headline section, and the logo floats just above the CTA with no alignment. B is a clean reflow on one left axis with readable steps in order and a clear headline and CTA; only the tiny legal text and the empty lower third count against it.

A keeps the original hierarchy, the 01-03 step order and a consistent left margin, so it reads as the same design; its minor flaws are the unreadable fine print and loose bottom spacing. B is unusable: the steps are reordered 03/01/02 and shrunk to illegible specks, 02 drifts to the right edge, the logo sits below the subhead, and the layout has no grid.
